name: claude-desktop-mods
description: Claude Code mods for the Code tab and terminal: /handoff-to asks for a Markdown brief a session in another repository can act on, and a band copies any brief a reply holds or shows it in a pane; /context-view opens a pane showing what fills the session context (window, instructions loaded, Markdown read, a devbook lens) with a ctx status line entry. Writes nothing to disk. Claude-only.
